items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: I played with Chris Kelly, one job. One job, one job only, just one job, one night.

ctx.x: I didn't hear Kid Rene was, maybe his brother was with him down in the Cadillac, on St. Claude, way down in 1942, but he, that was near the end of his life, he wasn't playing so well then I guess. He seemed to be tired out that night. Any other small bands? Did you ever play with Chris Kelly, for instance?
I played with Chris Kelly, one job. One job, one job only, just one job, one night. Funny thing about it, I don't want to work with that fellow anymore.
Was he a tough one to work with?
